subject: Clarify: latest SOC 2 evidence and interim coverage for Acme Health
messages:
From: Carol Ross <carol.ross@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence — need latest report / interim coverage question

Hi Soojin,

We're working through procurement for our Redwood integration and need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any interim documentation that proves coverage through our contract start date (01-Jan-2027). The report you previously uploaded in the portal appears to be dated through 2026-06-30; our security team is asking whether you have: 1) a reissued report that extends the audit window, or 2) a bridge attestation that covers 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31.

Can you confirm which of the above we should attach to our security package? If you can provide signed evidence this week that would be ideal — deadline for our vendor approval is 2027-03-26.

Thanks,
Carol
Carol Ross
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
carol.ross@acmehealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Carol Ross <carol.ross@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence — need latest report / interim coverage question

Hi Carol — thanks for flagging this and for the deadline. Quick summary:

- The public SOC 2 Type II we have posted is "SOC2_TypeII_2026-06-30.pdf" which covers the period ending 2026-06-30. That was our last issued Type II.
- We do have a signed bridge attestation that covers 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31; security prepared it to cover customers whose procurement windows fall between audits.
- Separately, our auditor is preparing a reissued consolidated cover letter that clarifies dating for the 2026 audit period (expected next week). We expect the reissue to reduce confusion but it will not retroactively change the original report period — the bridge is the intended interim evidence.

Marissa (cc'd) will attach the signed bridge PDF and our security note. Sean, I'm looping you for procurement / commercial acceptance.

Would the bridge attestation + the 2026 Type II PDF be acceptable for Acme Health's approval? If so, we'll send the signed files and a DocuSign confirmation.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Our customer procurement has a hard vendor approval date of 2027-03-26 and we want to provide signed evidence. Attachment: SOC2_bridge_attestation_2026Q3.pdf (draft).

Thanks —
Marissa

marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Next steps:
- We'll send an embedded DocuSign envelope to Marissa's attention (link below).
- Expect a signed PDF back within 24 hours of envelope completion.

Subject: Final: signed bridge attestation + existing Type II for Acme Health procurement

Hi Carol —

Following up with the artifacts for your security packet: attached are the signed bridge attestation and the current SOC 2 Type II PDF. Summary below:

Attachments sent:
- SOC2_TypeII_2026-06-30.pdf (current Type II covering period ending 2026-06-30)
- SOC2_bridge_attestation_2026Q3.pdf (signed by Indigo Audit; covers 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31)
- DocuSign confirmation: DocuSign_bridge_acceptance_Indigo.pdf

To confirm: the bridge attestation is intended as interim evidence to cover your contract start window. Our auditor is also issuing a clarifying cover letter next week that will be informational; the bridge + existing Type II are the formal evidence you can attach today.

Sean — can you confirm commercial acceptance on Acme's side and whether we should update HubSpot (DEAL-8943) to mark vendor evidence received?

Carol — if you need a short note from our legal team instead of the bridge, we can arrange that, but procurement typically accepts the signed attestation. If everything looks good I'll mark this as delivered and leave the renewal reminders with Rishi.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
